To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) a new model of the automata for the algorithmic task solving is proposed, (b) the new model is used to construct the variant of an algorithmic task, (c) the new model and the complexity functions are used for the students' solution estimation in virtual laboratories.
we have developed a new approach to solving algorithmic tasks in virtual laboratories based on automata models and complexity functions.

the proposed approach to the automation of variant preparation and solution estimation for algorithmic tasks based on automata models can be applied to the design of virtual laboratories for algorithmic courses.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of automating the process of variant preparation and the solution estimation of algorithmic tasks in virtual laboratories.
the problem of automating the preparation and solution estimation of algorithmic tasks.
the problem of developing the virtual laboratory, which is used to solve algorithmic tasks.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the work is very interesting, and it is well written.
the proposed model of automata and the complexity functions are a good tool for solving problems in the field of virtual laboratories.
the proposed model is applicable for solving the problems of variant preparation and estimation of the students’ solutions in the process of teaching the algorithms of algorithmic tasks.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have created a new model of automata for the solution of algorithmic problems and developed a method for solving the estimation of algorithmic tasks.

we have created a mathematical model for the complexity of the tasks of the virtual laboratory, which is based on the automata theory and allows to solve the problem of the automatic preparation of the tasks with the given complexity.

the described approach to the development of the virtual laboratories allows the creation of the educational environment, which is characterized by a large number of tasks, the ability to solve them with the help of different variants of the solution with a predetermined complexity and the estimation of the solution quality.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the complexity functions can be applied for the development of virtual laboratory systems, which are based on the algorithmic approach.
